comments.author: s8ga
comments.body_html:
In your case, you should install this on your Headless client.

This mod is primarily designed for situations where a client is connecting to an SPT Server that is not on the same machine.

If I understand your setup correctly:

  • PC A: Runs the SPT Server + your main Game Client.
  • PC B: Runs the Headless client (which connects to PC A). In this scenario, you definitely want to install the plugin on the Headless client on PC B.

To give you some context, here is my setup:

  • PC C: Runs the SPT Server + Headless.
  • PC D: My main Game Client. Because my Headless uses a Tailscale IP (which makes the plugin think it is on a different host), I install the mod on both my main Game Client and my Headless.

The “easy” way to do it: If you don’t want to worry about the technical details, just install it on both machines (Headless + SPT client). This plugin is very safe, doesn’t conflict with other mods, and has great compatibility. It will automatically provide a speed boost whenever it’s possible, and it won’t cause any harm if it’s not needed.

Very nice idea! Amazing result! And thank you, I found more efficient way for my SPT3, in ShouldAcquire method I simply disabled crc32 check. We have bundle: load, We don’t have bundle: download. So:

if (RequestHandler.IsLocal)
    return false;
if (VFS.Exists(GetBundleFilePath(bundle)))
    return false;
else
    return true;

Thank you SO MUCH for the idea! I started thinking about crc32 issue and now my friends have 5-15 seconds load time instead of 40-160+ seconds
